ddl.name: hosts_hostname_check
ddl.value: hostname = lower(hostname) and char_length(hostname) between 3 and 253

ddl.name: school_entitlements_bytes_check
ddl.value: pool_bytes > 0 and class_bytes > 0 and module_bytes > 0 and person_bytes > 0

ddl.name: school_entitlements_limits_check
ddl.value:
coalesce(students, 0) >= 0 and coalesce(staff_accounts, 0) >= 0
        and coalesce(video_hours, 0) >= 0 and coalesce(custom_domains, 0) >= 0
        and coalesce(email_per_month, 0) >= 0 and coalesce(caption_minutes, 0) >= 0

ddl.name: school_usage_counts_check
ddl.value: students >= 0 and staff_accounts >= 0 and signed_in_7d >= 0 and signed_in_30d >= 0 and video_minutes >= 0 and emails_this_month >= 0 and school_days_7d between 0 and 7 and failed_deliveries_1d >= 0

ddl.name: schools_check1
ddl.value: placement = 'cell' or legacy_school_id is not null

ddl.name: sso_domains_domain_check
ddl.value: domain = lower(domain) and char_length(domain) between 3 and 253
